info.random.replacement: Without repetitions, an item can only be selected once. With repetitions, the same item may occur several times.
info.datetime.weekday: The number follows ISO convention: Monday = 1 and Sunday = 7.
info.path.relative: A relative path is stored from the project folder. This lets the project and its files be moved without changing every path.
info.path.delete: Deleting a folder tree removes the folder and all of its contents. Use this mode carefully.
info.system.timeout: 0 means no time limit is applied.
info.csv.auto_types: Disabled by default: every cell remains text. When enabled, Boa tries to recognize numbers and booleans.
info.csv.excel: Adds a UTF-8 BOM so some Excel versions recognize accented characters correctly.
info.regex.pattern: Examples: \d+ for one or more digits, ^text for the beginning, text$ for the end, and .+ for at least one character.
info.text.format: Use fields in braces in the template, for example Hello {name}, then provide a dictionary containing the name key.
info.statistics.quantiles: The exclusive method is suitable for a sample. The inclusive method treats the values as the complete population.
info.encoding.errors: Strict raises an error. Replace inserts a replacement character. Ignore removes unsupported characters.
info.encoding.not_encryption: Encoding is reversible. It does not encrypt or protect the data.
info.digest.algorithms: SHA-256 is recommended. CRC32 only detects accidental errors. MD5 and SHA-1 are for legacy compatibility and must not secure data.
info.hmac: HMAC verifies integrity and possession of the secret key. It does not encrypt the content.
info.secrets: Use this block for passwords and tokens. The Random module is not intended for security.
info.uuid: A UUID is an identifier, not a password or secret token. UUID5 reproduces the same identifier with the same name and namespace.
info.archive.root: When enabled, the source folder itself appears in the archive. When disabled, only its contents are placed at the root.
info.archive.safety: Boa validates every path before extraction and rejects absolute paths or attempts to escape the destination folder.
info.archive.verify: A full verification reads the archive contents and may take time for a large file.
info.archive.zip_only: Direct modification is available for ZIP archives only.
